# Jesus Heals a Paralyzed Man (Mark 2:11)

## Emotional Focus
When something feels stuck or too hard to fix.

## Key KJV
“And he said unto the sick of the palsy, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.” (Mark 2:11)

## Gentle Retelling
Four friends lowered their paralyzed friend through the roof to Jesus. Jesus saw their faith, forgave the man’s sins, and told him to get up and walk. He did!

## Coloring Prompt
Friends lowering a man on a mat through a roof hole to Jesus who is reaching up with kindness.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Jesus has power over every hard thing. He can make us whole.”
